emojis.title: Israel and U.K. Cut Last-Minute Deal to Avoid Full Closure of British Consulate in East Jerusalem
emojis.summary: The diplomatic facility, in East Jerusalem, was under threat of being shut but will remain under a new name, the British foreign secretary said.

emojis.title: Skull fractures suggest servants of Egypt’s ancient kings were sacrificed
emojis.summary: Study of remains taken from royal cemetery at Umm el-Qa’ab appears to confirm early Egyptologist’s theory Court officials and craftspeople serving early Egyptian kings may have been sacrificed when their ruler died, according to research...

emojis.label: twin brothers adjust to freedom
emojis.title: For Twin Brothers Abducted in the Oct. 7 Attacks, Adjusting to Freedom Is a New Challenge
emojis.summary: Gali and Ziv Berman were taken hostage when their kibbutz was attacked on Oct. 7, 2023. They were freed a year ago but are still adjusting to freedom and trying to rebuild their lives.

emojis.label: spanish pensioner dies after protests
emojis.title: Spanish pensioner whose eviction sparked nationwide protests dies
emojis.summary: Maricarmen Abascal, 87, was forcibly removed on a stretcher from her apartment of more than 70 years in September.

emojis.label: maduro faces more charges
emojis.title: Former Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro expected to face more charges this week
emojis.summary: The new charges are expected to accuse Maduro and his wife of playing a role in the torture of Americans in Venezuelan prisons, US media reports.
